label: Quill overview: a narrated rundown of what Quill does. A woman on a video call scribbles notes; Quill's live notes fill in during a call; the meeting's notes and its transcript open after it; a man holds a key and speaks to his laptop, and his words are typed into a chat; Quill's privacy promise; a woman leans back with a coffee, laughing on her call; Quill's name, platforms and website.

music.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. A warm, optimistic, modern background track for a 50-second software product video: soft felt piano and gentle plucked guitar over a light, steady beat around 100 BPM, with a subtle lift at the 35-second mark and a clean, resolved ending. Calm, human and friendly, never busy, mixed to sit under a voiceover.

footage.negative: text, captions, logos, watermarks, readable screen content, distorted hands, extra fingers

scenes.say: You're on a call. You're listening, nodding along... and trying to type every word.

shot.footage: A woman in her thirties at a sunlit home office desk is on a video call on her laptop. She nods at the screen while typing notes hurriedly, glancing back and forth, a little overwhelmed. Filmed from the side at eye level, the laptop screen faces away from the camera. Natural window light, warm tones, handheld documentary style, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, realistic.

scenes.say: Quill takes the notes for you, live, while you talk. And no bot joins the call.
When it ends, you get the full write-up,
and a transcript that knows who said what.
Rather talk than type? Hold a key, and just say it.

shot.footage: Close-up of a man's hand resting on a laptop keyboard in a cozy apartment in the evening. His index finger presses and holds a key in the bottom-left corner of the keyboard. The camera slowly tilts up to his face as he leans in and speaks casually toward the laptop, relaxed and smiling. The laptop screen is not visible. Warm lamp light, cinematic, shallow depth of field, realistic.

scenes.say: Quill types it right where you are, in any app.
And it all happens on your computer. Your audio is never uploaded.
So you can stop taking notes, and actually listen.

shot.footage: A woman in her thirties at a sunlit home office desk is on a video call on her laptop. She leans back in her chair holding a coffee mug, hands away from the keyboard, listening and then laughing warmly at something said on the call, fully present. Filmed from the side at eye level, the laptop screen faces away from the camera. Natural window light, warm tones, handheld documentary style, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, realistic.

scenes.say: Quill. Meeting notes without the meeting bot. Free, for Mac and Windows.
